questions.modelAnswer: Set out the numbers in columns. Units: $7 + 6 = 13$, write $3$ carry $1$. Tens: $4 + 8 + 1 = 13$, write $3$ carry $1$. Hundreds: $3 + 5 + 1 = 9$. Answer: $933$.
Collect the like terms: $5x + 3x = 8x$, then $8x - 2x = 6x$. Answer: $6x$.

questions.stem: A rectangle measures $9$ cm by $4$ cm. Work out its perimeter.
questions.modelAnswer: Perimeter is the distance all the way round: $9 + 4 + 9 + 4 = 26$. Answer: $26$ cm.
Add $7$ to both sides: $3x = 11 + 7 = 18$. Divide both sides by $3$: $x = 6$. Check: $3(6) - 7 = 18 - 7 = 11$ ✓

questions.stem: The three angles of a triangle are $x$, $2x$ and $60^\circ$. Work out the value of $x$.
markscheme: M1: $x + 2x + 60 = 180$ (angles in a triangle sum to $180^\circ$)
questions.modelAnswer: Angles in a triangle add to $180^\circ$: $x + 2x + 60 = 180$. Collect: $3x = 120$, so $x = 40$. The angles are $40^\circ$, $80^\circ$ and $60^\circ$ — they sum to $180^\circ$ ✓

questions.stem: Work out $\dfrac{3}{4} - \dfrac{2}{5}$. Give your answer in its simplest form.
questions.modelAnswer: The lowest common denominator of $4$ and $5$ is $20$. Convert: $\dfrac{3}{4} = \dfrac{15}{20}$ and $\dfrac{2}{5} = \dfrac{8}{20}$. Subtract: $\dfrac{15}{20} - \dfrac{8}{20} = \dfrac{7}{20}$. Since $7$ is prime, this is already in simplest form.

questions.stem: A sequence begins $5, 9, 13, 17, \ldots$ Find the $20$th term of the sequence.
markscheme: M1: common difference $4$ identified and used to build an nth-term rule
questions.modelAnswer: The terms increase by $4$ each time, so the rule starts $4n$. The first term is $5$, and $4(1) = 4$, so we add $1$: nth term $= 4n + 1$. For $n = 20$: $4(20) + 1 = 81$.

questions.stem: A jacket costs £48. In a sale, the price is reduced by $15\%$. Work out the sale price.
markscheme: M1: $10\%$ of £48 $=$ £4.80 and $5\% =$ £2.40 (or equivalent non-calculator strategy)
questions.modelAnswer: Find $15\%$ without a calculator: $10\%$ of £48 is £4.80, and $5\%$ is half of that, £2.40. So $15\%$ is $4.80 + 2.40 = 7.20$ pounds. Sale price: $48 - 7.20 = 40.80$, i.e. £40.80.
